description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament te tipologjise 2+1+2 per shitje, ne zonen e Ali Demit.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndertim te ri, qe pritet te perfundoje ne vitin 2025.
Siperfaqe totale 110,51 m2 dhe siperfaqe e brendshme 95,90 m2.
Planimetri e rregullt e organizuar ne nje korridor te vogel hyres, po ashtu ne hyrje te apartamentit kemi tualetin e pare.
Shtrirja e ambjenteve ndahet ne te djathte ne sallonin e ndenjes, ambjentin e gatimit, ballkon.
Ne anen e majte kemi 2 dhomat e gjumit, ne ate matrimoniale kemi dhe tualetin e dyte.
Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug.
Per me shume informacione, me kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Ali Demi!
description_en: We offer a 2+1+2 typology apartment for sale, in the Ali Demi area. The apartment is located in a new building, which is expected to be completed in 2025. Total area 110.51 m2 and internal area 95.90 m2. Regular layout organized in a small entrance corridor, also at the entrance of the apartment we have the first toilet. The extent of the premises is divided on the right into the living room, the kitchen area, the balcony. On the left side we have the 2 bedrooms, in the matrimonial one we have the second toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South. For more information, contact me!
